title: spec frontmatter (docs/specs/<name>.md)
$comment: Hestia 0042 (frontmatter-fact-ledger, crossing agent-slack 0022). spec-craft writes a spec with no frontmatter: a `# ` title and a `status:` line above the first `## `, and that stays valid (a spec with no frontmatter is checked as the empty object). A spec that is amended carries frontmatter with `amendments:`, the list the laptop indexer reads into `amendment` facts (key spec, n, n being the amendment's 1-based place in amendments). Frontmatter wins for title and status. A spec that fails is a counted warning and gives no fact (still read for the kb as before). Owner: Hephaistos. The cause enum is the run-record schema's.

amendments.description: NEW (0042, Q-c): every amendment, oldest first; the body keeps its `## Amendment <date>` text

card.description: the card whose build or review proved the spec wrong, by slug

what.description: one line, kept and never counted

cause.description: the cause enum (0042 Q5, Hephaistos); the same values as run-record.schema.json $defs.cause

oneOf.description: approach or context was wrong or missing
the way was right, the work was not
the gate or the spec asked the wrong thing, or was unclear
not known when written; never guessed
